description: Ace to Five of Swords in tarot: upright and reversed meanings for each card, how they form a story of thought and strain, and how to use them in a spread.
lede: The Ace to Five of Swords run from clear thinking into strain, rest and conflict. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.

faces.alt: Five original gold-linework tarot card faces in a row, in order: Ace of Swords, Two of Swords, Three of Swords, Four of Swords and Five of Swords. Each shows its number and a sword icon with the card name beneath. No scenes are drawn.
faces.caption: Ace to Five of Swords in order, shown as simple number-and-suit card faces.
